delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: How {{project}}'s work gets delivered and when open work is likely done, from what Orchester recorded.

unreadRuns.one: 1 run's record couldn't be read; what it did is left out.
unreadRuns.other: {{count}} runs' records couldn't be read; what they did is left out.

throughput.title: Throughput
throughput.byDay: Tasks merged per day, in Orchester or found merged outside it
throughput.byWeek: Tasks merged per week, in Orchester or found merged outside it

empty.title: Nothing merged
empty.detail: No task's work was merged in this period.

cycle.title: Cycle time
cycle.subtitle: From a task's first agent start to the merge; lead time from its creation
cycle.noCycle: No cycle time: no agent of these tasks started; their work was merged outside a run.

empty.title: No task merged
empty.detail: Cycle and lead time are measured when a task's work is merged.

time.title: Where time goes
time.subtitle: Active agent time per pipeline step, and how often its work was returned
time.noAttempts: No task merged in this period

empty.title: No agent worked
empty.detail: No step of this project's runs started in this period.

flow.title: Cumulative flow
flow.subtitle: Tasks in each workflow status at the end of each day; canceled tasks are left out

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.detail: The flow starts with the project's first task.

forecast.title: Delivery forecast
forecast.subtitle: When open work is likely done: a Monte Carlo over the tasks merged on recent days
forecast.rule: A forecast rests on the tasks merged on each of the project's last 30 whole days, not before its first task. With fewer than 10 days or fewer than 3 tasks merged in them it gives no date.

queue.title: Merge queue
queue.lead: Runs that passed every step deliver into {{base}} one at a time, first finished first.
queue.leadNoBase: Runs that passed every step deliver into their base branch one at a time, first finished first.
queue.readFailed: The merge queue couldn't be read
queue.readFailedBody: {{reason}} The queue goes on delivering; try reading it again.

section.waitingNote: First finished first. Move up or to the top to change the order.
section.approvalNote: Doesn't hold the queue: later runs go ahead.

blocked.uncommittedTitle: Delivery is blocked: {{base}} has uncommitted changes in your checkout
blocked.uncommittedBody: Orchester never merges into a checkout with uncommitted changes. Commit or stash the changed files in {{path}}; delivery continues by itself once the checkout is clean.
blocked.otherBranchTitle: Delivery is blocked: your checkout is not on {{base}}
blocked.otherBranchBody: Orchester merges only into a checkout of {{base}}. Check out {{base}} in {{path}}; delivery continues by itself once it is.
blocked.inProgressTitle: Delivery is blocked: a merge is in progress in your checkout
blocked.inProgressBody: Finish or abort it in {{path}}; delivery continues by itself once it is done.
blocked.heldTitle: Delivery is blocked: a local integration holds your checkout
blocked.heldBody: Finish it on its task's page; delivery continues by itself once it is done.
blocked.held: Held until the checkout is clean

meta.checked: Run #{{run}} · {{pipeline}} · Check on the merged result passed on {{base}} {{revision}}

detail.baseMoved: {{base}} moved since the check: Review & merge syncs and checks again first.
detail.cleared: Worktree and code index removed · branch {{branch}} deleted
detail.clearedKeptBranch: Worktree and code index removed · branch {{branch}} kept
detail.notCleared: The worktree stayed: remove it from the task page
detail.checkFailed: Check on the merged result failed: {{tool}}
detail.checkFailedSaid: Check on the merged result failed: {{tool}} said {{detail}}
detail.keepsMoving: {{base}} keeps moving: it moved during each of {{count}} checks ({{heads}}).
detail.laterRun: The task has a later run; this one is not delivered.

phase.checkPassed: Check on the merged result · passed

empty.title: Nothing in the merge queue
empty.body: A run joins the queue when every step of its pipeline passed and the pipeline ends in a Deliver step. Runs deliver into their base branch one at a time, first finished first.
empty.none: No Deliver step: its runs end in Ready for review and you merge them from the task.
empty.noPipelines: The project has no published pipeline yet.

step.title: Deliver
step.approveBody: The run waits in Needs you; you review it and merge.
step.autoBody: Merges into the base branch when every step passed and Check passed on the merged result.
step.pullRequestBody: Opens a pull request instead of merging.
step.mergeCommitReadBack: The base branch gets a merge commit; the run's commits stay as they are.
step.squashTitle: The task's key and title, e.g. KON-16: Rate-limit messages
step.squashBody: Body: a short summary of the work and the run's number
step.integratorReadBack: Integrate runs with this profile when syncing with the base branch conflicts.
step.integratorUnknown: Fix the pipeline's steps first: the profiles that can resolve conflicts come from them.
step.noIntegrator: No step of this pipeline can change files, so conflicts go to you.
step.unknownProfile: A profile not in the project
step.recheck: Re-run Check on the merged result
step.recheckReadBack: Runs {{tools}} again after syncing with the base branch. A run never merges on a check of an older base.
step.recheckNoTools: The pipeline has no command tool step to run again on the merged result.
step.recheckOff: Off: a run merges once it is synced with the base, without checking the merged result again.
step.recheckLocked: Always on for Auto-merge: nothing merges without a passing check on the merged result.
step.noneBody: Runs of this pipeline end in Ready for review and you merge them from the task. With a Deliver step, a run that passed every step joins the project's merge queue and is delivered into its base branch.
step.chipNone: No Deliver step · runs end in Ready for review

task.joiningBody: Every step passed. The run joins the project's merge queue now and is delivered into {{base}} in its turn.
task.queuedBody: Every step passed. The run waits its turn in the merge queue: runs deliver one at a time, first finished first.
task.deliveringBody: Every step passed. The run was synced with {{base}} and Check runs again on the merged result; you approve the merge after it passes.
task.deliveringAutoBody: Every step passed. The run was synced with {{base}} and Check runs again on the merged result; it merges once Check passes.
task.deliveringNoCheckBody: Every step passed. The run is synced with {{base}} and merges in its turn, without checking the merged result again.
task.integratingBody: Syncing with {{base}} {{revision}} conflicted in {{count}} files. {{integrator}} resolves them in the run's worktree, re-runs Check and reviews its resolution; then delivery goes on.

blocked.uncommitted: Your checkout of {{base}} has uncommitted changes. Orchester never merges into it then; delivery continues by itself once it is clean.
blocked.otherBranch: Your checkout is not on {{base}}. Delivery continues by itself once {{base}} is checked out.
blocked.inProgress: A merge is in progress in your checkout. Delivery continues by itself once it is finished or aborted.
blocked.held: A local integration holds your checkout. Delivery continues by itself once it is done.

merged.title: Merged into {{base}} · {{revision}}
merged.mergeCommit: Merged with a merge commit at {{time}}.
merged.mergeCommitChecked: Merged with a merge commit at {{time}} after Check passed on the merged result.
merged.squashChecked: Squashed into one commit at {{time}} after Check passed on the merged result.
merged.cleared: The run's worktree, its code index and the branch {{branch}} were removed.
merged.clearedKept: The run's worktree and its code index were removed; the branch {{branch}} was kept.
merged.notCleared: The run's worktree stayed; remove it from Runs of this task.

check.resynced: Re-synced {{resyncs}} times: {{base}} moved during the check · now {{revision}} · clean
check.integrating: Resolving {{count}} files in the run's worktree
check.integrated: Resolved {{count}} files · the run passed every step again
check.check: Deliver · Check on the merged result

decision.readyBody: Every step passed and Check passed on the merged result with {{base}} {{revision}}.
decision.readyNoCheckBody: Every step passed and the run is synced with its base.
decision.afterwardsValue: Worktree, code index and branch removed
decision.readyNote: If {{base}} moves before you merge, Orchester syncs and checks again first. Waiting here doesn't hold the merge queue.
decision.conflictsBody: Resolve the conflicts yourself in the run's worktree, or reject the run.
decision.resolveNote: Shows the worktree and checks your resolution before the run goes back in the merge queue.
decision.rejectNote: The run is not merged; {{base}} stays as it is.
decision.takeOutNote: The run leaves the merge queue; then you merge it from this page as any run.

failed.title: Integrate couldn't resolve the conflicts with {{base}}
failed.body: Syncing with {{base}} {{revision}} conflicted in {{count}} files and {{integrator}} could not resolve them. The run left the merge queue; {{base}} stays as it is.

resolve.title: Resolve the conflicts with {{base}}
resolve.body: The run's worktree holds the merge of {{base}} {{revision}} into {{branch}}. Resolve the conflicting files there, then press I've resolved it.
resolve.when: When you press I've resolved it
resolve.mergesDetail: With {{base}} as it is then, not only the commit merged now
resolve.checkDetail: The run's steps after Integrate pass again, then Check runs on the merged result
resolve.backDetail: Then your approval and the merge, as before

details.title: Delivery
details.noIntegrator: You · no step can resolve conflicts
